Synopsis:
It must be summer's fault

During the long summer break, Seina's daily routine was to finish her homework and then play with her nipples. One day, her childhood friend Momoka walked into her room in the middle of it and saw what she was doing. Desperate for an excuse, she lied and said she was "imitating something from a manga she was reading," but Momoka replied, "I'll help you"...!?
